slides.text: Write it once, check it once, and publish it everywhere it needs to go.

slides.title: Most effort today goes into re-formatting
points: Content is copied into a new file for every audience
Each copy is formatted by hand, then corrected separately
Late edits must be repeated in every copy
slides.takeaway: The time goes into copies, not content. Remove the copies and the time comes back.
